Eye sockets, irises, and pupils fit from the front. The body uses a D-shaped pin; the head uses two asymmetric locating pins.

Designed for glue-assisted assembly. Nose rims were locally reconstructed to remove thin folds.

This offline viewer embeds preview meshes derived from the actual 13-part Blender result. Display meshes are simplified; this page does not rerun segmentation, provide manufacturing files, or slice a model. Digital checks do not replace a physical trial print.
